chunks: Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah, from Musa ibn al-Hasan, from al-Hasan ibn al-Husayn al-Luʾluʾi, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from al-Harith ibn al-Mughirah al-Nadri, and ʿUmar ibn Hanzalah, and Mansur ibn Hazim, who said: We used to measure the sun in al-Madinah by the cubit, so Abu ʿAbd Allah عليه السلام said to us:

Shall I not inform you of something clearer than this? They said, We said: Yes, may Allah make us your ransom. He said: When the sun declines, the time of Zuhr has entered, except that before it there is a supererogatory prayer; and that is up to you. So if you make it brief, then it is when you finish your supererogatory prayer, and if you make it long, then it is when you finish your supererogatory prayer.

key_terms.زَالَتِ الشَّمْسُ: the sun declined from the meridian, marking the onset of Zuhr time
key_terms.سُبْحَةً: a supererogatory prayer performed before the obligatory prayer
key_terms.طَوَّلْتَ: you performed it at greater length
key_terms.وَقْتُ الظُّهْرِ: the prescribed time of Zuhr salat (prayer)

ai.seo_question: When does the time of Zuhr salat (prayer) begin according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the beginning of the time of Zuhr salat (prayer): it begins when the sun declines from the meridian. It also notes that a recommended supererogatory prayer may be performed before the obligatory Zuhr salat (prayer), and its length depends on the worshipper.
